topicSuggestion.questionZh: 名字里有氢，为什么还是碱性的？
topicSuggestion.summaryZh: 从加水、显色与加热的对照，追踪水、离子和产物，把现象变成可检验的解释。
topicSuggestion.summaryEn: Follow water, ions and products to turn contrasting observations into testable explanations.

cues.title: 同样加水，为何一热一冷？
cues.titleEn: The same water, opposite temperature changes
cues.caption: 外观相似，加水后的变化不同。
cues.captionEn: Similar solids respond differently to water.
cues.zh: 两份白色固体，看起来很像。按教材比较，加少量水后，碳酸钠结块并放热，碳酸氢钠溶解时吸热；继续加水，剩余固体也不同。温度和溶解量给了两条线索，但还没有解释原因。先跟住其中一组离子，看看它与水的关系怎样改变。
cues.en: These two white solids look similar. In the textbook comparison, a little water makes sodium carbonate clump and release heat, while dissolving bicarbonate absorbs heat. More water also leaves different amounts of solid. Those are clues, not explanations yet. Follow one group of ions as its surroundings change.

cues.title: 能量的两笔账
cues.titleEn: Two sides of the energy balance
cues.caption: 分开原有作用需能；形成新的水合作用放能。
cues.captionEn: Separating interactions costs energy; hydration releases it.
cues.zh: 把离子从原有邻居中分开，需要能量；水分子转向阴离子，形成新的水合作用，又释放能量。两笔账相抵，决定净热方向。教材中，碳酸钠与水作用时净放热；换成碳酸氢钠，溶解时净吸热。箭头只表示方向，长度不是测得的热量。
cues.en: Separating ions from their old neighbours requires energy. Water turns toward the anion, forming new attractions and releasing energy. The balance determines the net heat flow. In this comparison, carbonate releases heat as it interacts with water; bicarbonate draws heat in as it dissolves. The arrows show direction, not measured amounts of heat.

cues.title: 名字里有氢，为什么仍显碱性？
cues.caption: 颜色是线索，名字不能决定酸碱性。
cues.captionEn: Colour is a clue; a name does not determine acidity.
cues.zh: 再看酚酞：两种盐的水溶液都呈碱性，碳酸氢钠的显色可以很淡。不要把名字中的氢当成酸性的保证。教材两份固体的质量相近，却不等于溶液浓度相同。为单独比较离子的作用，接下来另设两份等浓度的稀溶液。
cues.en: Both solutions are alkaline, although bicarbonate can give a very faint indicator colour. Having hydrogen in the name does not guarantee an acidic solution. Equal solid masses also do not give equal solution concentrations. We now switch to a separate comparison of dilute solutions at the same concentration.

cues.title: 跟住水中的这个氢
cues.caption: 碱性来自与水的平衡，钠离子不生成OH⁻。
cues.captionEn: Alkalinity comes from equilibrium with water, not from sodium making OH⁻.
cues.zh: 看被标记的氢从水移向碳酸根：它成为碳酸氢根，水的一部分则成为氢氧根。钠离子留在旁边，没有制造氢氧根。碳酸氢根既能接受也能给出质子。先看它从水接受一个质子，留下氢氧根；再看它把质子给水，形成水合氢离子。连同水和溶解二氧化碳的平衡，所示溶液最终仍略偏碱。画面追踪的是净变化和守恒，不是原子真实运动的录像。
cues.en: The marked hydrogen moves from water to carbonate. Carbonate becomes bicarbonate, leaving hydroxide. Sodium remains a spectator. Bicarbonate can both accept and donate protons. Watch it accept a proton from water, leaving hydroxide. Now let it donate a proton to water, forming hydronium. With water and dissolved carbon dioxide also in equilibrium, this solution is still mildly alkaline. These are conserved net changes, not a recording of atomic motion.

cues.title: 颜色变淡，离子就消失了吗？
cues.titleEn: Does fading colour mean the ions disappeared?
cues.caption: 加水降低浓度；同一份碳仍在体系中。
cues.captionEn: Water lowers concentration; the same carbon remains.
cues.zh: 现在给同一份溶液加水，不再添加盐。含碳粒子的总量保持，体积变大，各种离子的比例也重新调整。模型显示碱性减弱，酚酞可以变淡，甚至看不出颜色。由此预测：颜色消失不能证明盐已消失，也不能仅凭酚酞断言溶液恰好中性。
cues.en: Add water without adding more salt. The total carbon stays the same, while volume grows and the equilibrium readjusts. Alkalinity decreases, and the indicator may become too faint to see. Fading colour therefore does not prove that the salt vanished, or that the solution is exactly neutral.

cues.title: 加热后，白色固体还是原来的物质吗？
cues.titleEn: After heating, is the white solid unchanged?
cues.caption: 相同检验装置，先建立无明显分解的对照。
cues.captionEn: Use the same detector to establish the comparison.
cues.zh: 换到教材的加热实验。碳酸钠和碳酸氢钠原本都是白色，加热后也可能留下白色固体，所以外观不能作最后判断。先看碳酸钠：在教材条件下没有明显分解，石灰水保持澄清。保持同一条气路，再换成碳酸氢钠。
cues.en: Heating leaves another identification problem: a white residue need not be the original substance. Start with carbonate. Under the textbook conditions it shows no appreciable decomposition, and the limewater stays clear. Keep the same gas path and replace the sample with bicarbonate.

cues.title: 跟住离开的碳和氢
cues.titleEn: Follow the carbon and hydrogen that leave
cues.caption: 同一批原子分到残渣、水和CO₂中。
cues.captionEn: The original atoms enter residue, water and CO₂.
cues.zh: 这次有气体沿导管进入石灰水，产生白色沉淀，较冷处还可出现水滴。把两个碳酸氢钠单位放大：一个碳留在碳酸钠中，另一个进入二氧化碳；两个氢进入水。钠全部留在固体。原子只是重新分配，不能把这幅净变化图当成真实的一步反应机理。
cues.en: Gas now reaches the limewater and produces a white precipitate; water can condense in the cooler region. Enlarge two bicarbonate units. One carbon stays in carbonate, the other enters carbon dioxide, and the two hydrogens enter water. All sodium remains in the solid. This is a net atom account, not a one-step reaction mechanism.

cues.title: 用留下多少，检验你的解释
cues.titleEn: Test the explanation with the residue
cues.caption: 质量减少是产物离开；预测要与残渣核对。
cues.captionEn: Mass falls because products leave; check the predicted residue.
cues.zh: 如果一克纯碳酸氢钠完全按这条反应转化，应留下约零点六三一克碳酸钠。水和二氧化碳补足其余质量。只反应一部分时，残渣还含未反应物，质量应更大。这个预测可以检验反应解释；再加热不继续失重是完成的线索，但单凭恒重或白色外观仍不能证明产物纯度。
cues.en: One gram of pure bicarbonate should leave about 0.631 grams of carbonate after complete conversion by this reaction. Water and carbon dioxide account for the rest. Partial conversion leaves more solid because some bicarbonate remains. This mass prediction can test the explanation. Constant mass after further heating is a completion clue, not proof of product purity.

sources.finding: 实验2-4各约1g、少量水观察晶体/热方向，后加5mL水及酚酞；正文只断言两溶液碱性。实验2-5同装置加热，比较热稳定性及CO₂。脚注列三种水合物。不得把各约1g当等摩尔或等浓度。
无水Na₂CO₃和NaHCO₃的水中热效应方向相反；分离相互作用需能，形成水合相互作用放能，净差决定温度方向。该课不同用量和温度不得移作人教实验读数。
稀水体系25°C可用Kw=10^-14、K1*=10^-6.35、K2=10^-10.33；应计入OH⁻。K1*为溶解CO₂/碳酸合并池的表观常数；不是纯H₂CO₃的本征第一电离常数。
